visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair and sunglasses holds a dark glass bottle with a white label in a selfie-style shot. Behind him, a crowd of people in casual and professional attire gathers in front of a modern building featuring a 'Snow Peak' sign. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) A wide exterior shot reveals a large, two-story modern retail building with a clean, minimalist facade. On the lawn in front, several large tan and black camping tarps are pitched, covering a display of outdoor tables and chairs. (3) The camera moves through glass doors into a spacious interior. Mannequins dressed in outdoor apparel (vests, jackets, bags) are positioned on wooden display blocks. The setting has high ceilings with exposed industrial pipes and warm studio lighting. (4) A man in a green utility vest walks through a well-lit clothing section. Racks of neutral-toned garments line the walls. More mannequins showcase stylized outdoor fashion. (5) The shot transitions to a cafe area within the store called 'Snow Peak Cafe'. It features a gray counter with espresso machines and baristas. Seating consists of camping tables and foldable camping chairs arranged on a light wood floor. (6) Close-up shots focus on specific apparel: a textured gray hoodie, a white down vest, a black crossbody bag, and various olive and tan hats displayed on a wooden table. Product information cards are visible nearby. (7) The scene shifts to the second floor, a large open space dedicated to camping gear. Multiple large tents are fully pitched on an artificial green turf area. A group of four men is seen sitting and talking inside one of the larger tents. (8) A dedicated pet section is shown, featuring pet-sized camping beds and a plush dog model. Racks nearby hold colorful pet leashes and harnesses. (9) A hand holds a vibrant purple titanium mug against a backdrop of a matching poster. The lighting highlights the metallic texture of the mug. (10) Outdoors again, a group of four men in suits and semi-formal wear use wooden mallets to strike the top of a traditional sake barrel (Kagami-biraki) during a ceremony. A crowd watches and films with smartphones under the bright sun.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a faint clink of glass, immediately followed by a male narrator's friendly, medium-pitched voice. The background features upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and light percussion. (2) As the narrator describes the store's exterior, the BGM continues at a steady level. Subtle ambient outdoor noise is barely audible. (3) The narration maintains a consistent, enthusiastic pace with clear articulation. The acoustic BGM provides a cheerful, bright backdrop. (4) Transitioning to the store's interior, the ambient noise shifts to a very low room tone. The narrator's voice remains dominant. (5) In the pet section, the narrator's tone becomes slightly more playful. The BGM remains unchanged. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's final sign-off, followed by a sudden loud 'thud' of wood hitting wood, then a burst of high-pitched cheering and applause from a crowd, marking the end of the ceremony.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to announce and showcase the grand opening of the Snow Peak flagship store in Tainan, Anping. It emphasizes the store's massive scale, its unique integration of a cafe, and the availability of exclusive regional products to attract outdoor enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logo, store location, and specific product promotion.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a mix of personal vlog style and professional store tour shots to create an inviting atmosphere for the brand's new location.
